payload.core_mechanism_summary: Try all possible column swaps (including no swap); for each, check if every row has at most 2 mismatches, meaning it can be fixed with a single row swap.
payload.rationale: The solution exhaustively enumerates over all pairs of columns to swap, and verifies row-feasibility. This is a complete search over the space of single column swaps, not a greedy construction. Among complete_search subtypes, permutation enumeration is the closest fit.
